newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Hirsch shares to be issued at 715 ATS.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Hirsch shares to be issued at 715 ATS.

text.p: Machinery and packaging maker Hirsch Servo AG said on Wednesday the price for the shares to be issued between June 13 and 19 had been fixed at 715 schillings a share with a nominal value of 100 schillings.
Hirsch will issue 160,200 common shares in an initial offering to be listed on the Vienna bourse's mid-cap segment called Fit, the company said in a statement.
Hirsch becomes the first issuer to debut on Fit.
The 140,000 new shares and 20,200 old shares represent 32 percent of the firm's equity capital. Hirsch last week said it planned to raise up to 118.5 million schillings in fresh funds.

The company reported pre-tax profit of 16.8 million schillings for its 1995/96 business year on group sales of 225.7 million schillings. It expects pre-tax profit to rise to 31.5 million schillings in 1996/97 and to 42.4 million in the following business year.
